verdict.rationale: Inngest's event-driven model and per-key concurrency controls (docs-12) support fanning out work across many items, and its REST API (docs-7) lets an AI-native user programmatically trigger and manage many function runs/events at scale. However, there is no explicit documentation of a bulk/batch operation feature (e.g., bulk trigger, batch cancel, or batch replay across many items) in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation API/feature docs (batch trigger, batch cancel, batch replay), independent confirmation of bulk-scale usage.
